We need to generate a JUnit 4 test file HtmlTreeBuilderStateTest.java that comprehensively tests all methods in the HtmlTreeBuilderState enum. Since the class is complex with many internal dependencies (Token, HtmlTreeBuilder, etc.). We can mock HtmlTreeBuilder and Token objects using Mockito or custom stubs to verify behavior of process methods. Since we need to test all methods: each enum constant's process method, plus any private helper methods like anythingElse, handleRcData, etc. But private methods can't be directly accessed; they are exercised via process.

Goal: comprehensive unit tests covering branches.

We need to create test class with multiple test methods, using mocks to simulate behavior and verify transitions, insertions, errors, returns.

We can use Mockito (common) to mock HtmlTreeBuilder and Token. We'll need to create Token subclasses or mock Token with appropriate behavior: isWhitespace, isComment, isDoctype, isStartTag, isEndTag, asComment, asDoctype, asStartTag, asEndTag, type etc.

Simplify: create minimal concrete Token implementations for needed types: Token.Character, Token.Comment, Token.Doctype, Token.StartTag, Token.EndTag, Token.EOF maybe.

But the code uses Token's fields: type, and methods isCharacter(), isComment(), etc. In jsoup source, Token is an abstract class with nested classes. For testing, we could use real jsoup Token classes if available on classpath. But we can't assume external libraries besides jsoup. However the source includes imports of org.jsoup.parser.Token, etc. In test environment, jsoup library should be present. We'll assume we have jsoup library.

Thus we can create Tokens using new Token.Character().data("text") etc. Use jsoup's Token classes.

We'll need to mock HtmlTreeBuilder to capture method calls: insert, transition, error, etc., and return values for methods like process(t) which may be called recursively.

We'll also need to mock methods like getDocument(), getHeadElement(), getStack(), getActiveFormattingElement, etc., but we can stub them to return default values.

Simplify: For many branches, we can just verify that certain methods are called or not called, and that the process method returns true/false as expected.

We'll write tests for a selection of states covering major branches: Initial, BeforeHtml, BeforeHead, InHead (start tag head, comment, doctype, unknown), InHeadNoscript, AfterHead, InBody (character whitespace, start tag a with active formatting element, start tag unknown), Text (character, EOF), InTable (character leading to InTableText), InTableText (character null, other), InCaption, InColumnGroup, InTableBody, InRow, InCell, InSelect, InSelectInTable, AfterBody, InFrameset, AfterFrameset, AfterAfterBody, AfterAfterFrameset, ForeignContent (trivial). Also test anyOtherEndTag via InBody.

Complex to mock all behavior.

We'll create a helper method createMockBuilder() that returns a mock HtmlTreeBuilder with default stubs: when(tb.settings).thenReturn(mock Settings) etc. But many methods are called; we can use Mockito's lenient().when(...).thenReturn(...) to avoid unnecessary stubbing.

Simplify: Use a Spy of a subclass of HtmlTreeBuilder that overrides methods to record calls. However HtmlTreeBuilder is a concrete class in jsoup, may have many dependencies. Could instead use Mockito to mock all methods used.

We'll need to stub methods used in each branch:

Common methods: insert(Token.Comment), insert(Token.Character), insertStartTag(String), insertStartTag(String, Attributes), insertEmpty, insert, insertMarkerToFormattingElements, transition(state), error(state), getDocument(), getHeadElement(), setHeadElement, framesetOk(), framesetOk(boolean), inButtonScope(String), inScope(String), inTableScope(String), inTableScope, inTableScope, inSelectScope, etc. Many.

We can stub them to return simple values (e.g., getDocument returns mock Document). For methods returning boolean, we can return true/false as needed.

But we need to control behavior for branches: e.g., InHead processing start tag "title" triggers handleRcData which sets tokeniser state etc. We can verify that tokeniser.transition called with TokeniserState.Rcdata.

Thus we need to stub tb.tokeniser and tb.settings.

Simplify: Use Mockito's mock for HtmlTreeBuilder with deep stubs: mock(HtmlTreeBuilder.class, RETURNS_DEEP_STUBS). This allows chained calls like tb.settings.normalizeTag(...). We'll need to import static org.mockito.Mockito.*; Use deep stubs.

Create test methods:

1. testInitialWhitespaceIgnored: token = new Token.Character().data(" "); tb = mock with deep stub. Call HtmlTreeBuilderState.Initial.process(token, tb). Expect true and no interactions (maybe no insert). Verify that tb.insert never called.

2. testInitialDoctypeCreatesDocumentTypeAndTransition: create Token.Doctype with name "html". Provide tb.getDocument() returns mock Document. Expect tb.getDocument().appendChild called with DocumentType; tb.transition called with BeforeHtml.

3. testBeforeHtmlStartTagHtml: token StartTag "html". Expect tb.insert called, tb.transition to BeforeHead.

4. testBeforeHtmlEndTagHeadTriggersAnythingElse: token EndTag "head". Expect tb.insertStartTag called with "html", tb.transition(BeforeHead), and tb.process called again.

5. testInHeadStartTagMeta: token StartTag "meta". Expect tb.insertEmpty called.

6. testInHeadStartTagTitle: token StartTag "title". Expect tb.tokeniser.transition(TokeniserState.Rcdata) and tb.transition(Text) and tb.insert called.

7. testInHeadEndTagHead: token EndTag "head". Expect tb.pop, tb.transition(AfterHead).

8. testInHeadAnythingElse: token StartTag "div". Expect anythingElse -> tb.processEndTag("head") then tb.process token.

9. testInHeadNoscriptStartTagHtml: token StartTag "html". Expect tb.process(t, InBody) called.

10. testInHeadNoscriptEndTagNoscript: token EndTag "noscript". Expect tb.pop and transition InHead.

11. testTextCharacter: token Character "a". Expect tb.insert called.

12. testTextEOF: token EOF. Expect tb.error called, tb.pop, tb.transition originalState, then tb.process(t) called.

13. testInTableCharacterTriggersInTableText: token Character "a". Expect tb.newPendingTableCharacters, tb.markInsertionMode, tb.transition(InTableText), then tb.process called.

14. testInTableStartTagCaption: token StartTag "caption". Expect tb.clearStackToTableContext, insertMarkerToFormattingElements, insert, transition InCaption.

15. testInTableEndTagTable: token EndTag "table". Expect tb.inTableScope true, tb.popStackToClose, tb.resetInsertionMode.

16. testInTableAnythingElseFosterInserts: token StartTag "div". Should call tb.error and then process in InBody with foster inserts if current element is table etc. Hard to verify, but we can set tb.currentElement().nodeName() to "table". Use mock for currentElement returning mock Element with nodeName "table". Verify tb.setFosterInserts(true) called.

17. testInTableTextCharacterNullString: token Character with data nullString (char 0). Expect error and false.

18. testInTableTextOtherSwitches: token StartTag "div". Should flush pending characters and transition back.

19. testInCaptionEndTagCaption: token EndTag "caption". Expect generateImpliedEndTags, popStackToClose, clearFormattingElementsToLastMarker, transition InTable.

20. testInCaptionStartTagOther: token StartTag "div". Expect tb.process(t, InBody) called.

21. testInColumnGroupWhitespace: token Character whitespace, expect insert.

22. testInColumnGroupStartTagCol: token StartTag "col". Expect insertEmpty.

23. testInColumnGroupEndTagColgroup: token EndTag "colgroup". Expect pop and transition InTable.

24. testInTableBodyStartTagTr: token StartTag "tr". Expect clearStackToTableBodyContext, insert, transition InRow.

25. testInTableBodyEndTagTbody: token EndTag "tbody". Expect clearStackToTableBodyContext, pop, transition InTable.

26. testInRowStartTagTd: token StartTag "td". Expect clearStackToTableRowContext, insert, transition InCell, insertMarkerToFormattingElements.

27. testInRowEndTagTr: token EndTag "tr". Expect clearStackToTableRowContext, pop, transition InTableBody.

28. testInCellEndTagTd: token EndTag "td". Expect generateImpliedEndTags, popStackToClose, clearFormattingElementsToLastMarker, transition InRow.

29. testInSelectStartTagOptionWhenCurrentOption: token StartTag "option" with current element option. Need to mock tb.currentElement().nodeName() returns "option". Expect tb.processEndTag("option") then tb.insert.

30. testAfterBodyStartTagHtml: token StartTag "html". Expect process InBody.

31. testAfterBodyEndTagHtmlFragment: tb.isFragmentParsing returns true, expect error false.

32. testAfterBodyOtherToken: token StartTag "div". Expect error, transition InBody, process token.

33. testInFramesetStartTagFrameset: token StartTag "frameset". Expect insert.

34. testInFramesetEndTagFramesetWhenNotHtml: token EndTag "frameset". Expect pop and maybe transition AfterFrameset.

35. testAfterFramesetStartTagNoFrames: token StartTag "noframes". Expect process in InHead.

36. testAfterAfterBodyComment: token Comment. Expect insert.

37. testForeignContentAlwaysTrue.
